input: Organize all my digital photos by year

gold.taskTitle: Organize all digital photos by year
gold.taskDescription: Sort and restructure the user's entire digital photo collection into a year-based folder or album system.

questions.title: Where are the photos currently stored?
questions.description: Identify the storage location(s): local hard drive, external drive, cloud service, phone, or a combination.

questions.title: How many photos are we roughly talking about?
questions.description: Get a sense of the collection size to estimate effort and choose the right approach.

questions.title: What operating system or device will you use?
questions.description: Determine whether the user is on Windows, Mac, iOS, Android, or another platform to recommend compatible tools.

questions.title: Should photos stay in folders or go into an app?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants plain year-named folders or organized albums inside a photo management app like Google Photos or Apple Photos.

questions.title: What date should determine the year — taken or modified?
questions.description: Establish whether to sort by the date the photo was captured, the file creation date, or the last modified date.

questions.title: Are there duplicate photos that need to be handled?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants duplicates identified and removed as part of the organization process.

questions.title: Should the original files be moved or copied?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants photos relocated into new folders or copied so originals remain untouched as a backup.
